utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Nell! I was just trying to remember—did we settle on Saturday or Sunday for the repair drive? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Cleo said Saturday morning at the community center—I'm pretty sure that's the date.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning—right, right! Thanks Nell. I'd lose my head if it wasn't screwed on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, I'm hoping you can help me figure out what tools we're still missing for Saturday's repair drive. Got a list I'm working on.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive! Right, that's this Saturday? Or was it Sunday? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's Saturday morning, Noah. Don't worry, I've got it marked. I'm trying to track down a few more wrenches and screwdrivers—any chance you've got some to spare?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the screwdrivers ready for Saturday. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo. I'll have my toolbox ready. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sam! I'm glad I ran into you—are you all set for the repair drive tomorrow? Rosa's got the check-in table ready, and I'm bringing extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's awesome, Mara! I'm pretty much set—just need to make sure we've got enough volunteers. Are you up for helping folks with electronics?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'd love to help with electronics! I'm pretty handy with that stuff.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I was there when they patched up the roof—water used to pour in every storm, but now it's solid as can be.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You saw it yourself? Well, I still find it hard to believe, but I can't argue with a dry roof.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Eli, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster down—maybe they can work their magic on it!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's good, Tess, but have you signed up on the sheet? We need to keep track of all the items coming in so nothing gets lost.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I didn't know there was a sign-up sheet! Where do I find it? I sure don't want my toaster getting mixed up with someone else's.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Bo, it's a community thing—we're all pitching in to fix up the Andersons' car this Saturday. You should swing by if you can spare an hour!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I heard we're coordinating the repair supplies too — I already mapped out where we can store the tools so they don't get mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's a great idea, Opal! I'll make sure to label my wrenches when I bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's just a small effort to help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, right. Well, I'm glad you've got it handled—I gotta run, but holler if you need anything urgent.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Leo, Saturday morning it is! Rey, can you still cover the pickup at noon?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, sure, I can do that. I’ll grab the level from Gus and swing by the drop-off point.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Rey! That noon pickup will be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to help out with fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Vik, that's wonderful! We could really use someone with your energy on the playground — I'll make sure to note you down for that.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'll be there fixing the swings, and I'll remind everyone about the paint job too. Ira mentioned stopping by to help paint the benches.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, so what time should I show up and what do you want me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Anytime between 9 and noon works, Mina! Bring whatever tools you’ve got—wrenches, screwdrivers, anything that helps fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, 9 to noon and I'll bring my toolbox. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, 9 to noon at your garage—got it. But are you absolutely sure you have enough room for all the tools people are bringing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Pia, sorry I'm late—did I miss the tool count? I can always stash some at my place if the garage gets too crowded.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Dane, good you're here! I was just worried about space—if your garage is free, maybe we should split the drop-off between the two of you to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great. I might need a hand fixing my fence, actually. You got a level you could spare?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, I've got a level I can bring. I'll be there by 10—just remind me to grab it from the trunk.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia. I'll make sure to remind you when we head over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey, I've got a level you can borrow. Just bring it back when you're done.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I saw it fix Mrs. Henderson's porch step this morning. Solid work, that group does.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I almost forgot—I heard they might even do bike tune-ups! I’m definitely bringing my squeaky chain over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, that's perfect! I bet Vik would be thrilled to help with that—he's a whiz with bike chains.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Vik? He's the best! I saw him fix a rusty chain in ten minutes flat last summer.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Vik, have you actually seen the repair drive work on the water pump, or is this still just something people are talking about?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Well, I know Ira's planning to help paint the benches, and I'll be fixing the swings—I'll remind everyone about the water pump too if it comes up!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, so you haven't seen the repair drive fix the pump yourself? Because I'd rather not spread something that might just be hearsay.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, just let me know the time and what tools I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's at 10 AM, and I think wrenches and a socket set would be perfect. I'll see you there!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, ten it is. I'll bring my wrenches and socket set. Anything else I should know?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! Uli mentioned it. Is it this weekend or next?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It's next week, actually—we're all meeting at the community center at 10am. Eli's gonna be there sharp.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Next week at 10? Got it, I'll try to remember that. Thanks, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Quinn, can you help me figure out who's picking up the kids on Saturday? I don't want anyone double-booked.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, sure thing, Faye! Let me spread the word—I'll check with Eli and Pia too. I think we can sort it all out while people drop off tools for the repair drive tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Quinn! Let me know what Eli and Pia say, and I'll adjust the pickup schedule accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli, are you all set for the repair drive tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I think so. Just hoping the weather holds up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good, me too! I've got a toolbox in the car just in case we need extra.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I've got my schedule all set for the repair drive next week. What time should I be at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, actually the repair drive is this weekend, not next week. Can you make it Saturday morning around 9?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What? This weekend? That throws my whole schedule off. Let me check my calendar—I was planning for next week.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Leo, have you heard about the repair drive at the community center this Saturday? I'm thinking of bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm helping out. Got some spare tools. See you there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll be there at 9 with my toaster. Thanks for helping out, Leo!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mara, I am! And I just got Opal onboard to lead the plumbing coordination — she's already mapped the shut-off valves. We're in great shape.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've got those valve locations fresh in mind. Happy to take the lead on that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal! I'll put you down as the plumbing lead — and Mara, we'll need your help with tool inventory in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Bo—was it Saturday or Sunday? I swear I wrote it down somewhere, but I can't find the note.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Honestly, I think it's Saturday, but don't quote me on that—I'm just skimming the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday! That sounds right. I'll double-check with Mara and let you know for sure—don't want to show up on the wrong day again.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
